02:22:58  ✦ the caretaker (speak to Shelby): Something lands heavy across your arms out of the dark — cured leather, cracked at the shoulder, still smelling faintly of smoke. It was never in this cave. It is now. Whatever heard you does not speak; it only answers, and not twice for the same thing. The dagger stays a dagger. Wear the armor before you go in.
